errors.text_span: Диапазонът на оста X е от 3 до 6, като всяка единица представлява един месец, и е разделен на години (2020 г., 2021 г., 2022 г.) за по-лесно четене.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the range of the X-axis is from 3 to 6. The axis actually represents a time series from March 2020 to June 2022, where the numbers represent months within the specified years.
The description states the line is black, but it is clearly dark blue in the figure.

errors.text_span: достига максимум от около 6,5% в май 2020 г. (етикет „5“)
errors.evidence: The description states that the maximum of ~6.5% occurs in May 2020 (label '5'). However, the chart shows this peak occurring in April 2020 (label '4'). The value in May 2020 is slightly lower, around 6%.

errors.text_span: След това се възстановява до около 6% към средата на 2021 г. (етикет „12“)
errors.evidence: This statement is factually incorrect. The value does not recover to 6% in 2021. The value at the end of 2021 (label '12') is approximately 2.1%. Additionally, 'средата на 2021 г.' (middle of 2021) contradicts 'етикет „12“' (label '12'), which is the end of the year.

errors.text_span: след което рязко пада до около 2,5% в юли 2021 г. (етикет „7“)
errors.evidence: The description misplaces the timing of the sharp fall. The most dramatic drop in the data occurs between May 2021 (from ~6.5%) and June 2021 (to ~3%), not in July.

errors.text_span: достигайки минимум от около 1,5% в март 2022 г. (етикет „3“)
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies March 2022 (label '3') as a minimum of ~1.5%. According to the chart, March 2022 is a local peak of approximately 2.9%.
